text: Component evidence kinds are attributed independently (#274, #276). A report can carry supplied assumption records beside proof results. Each record names a declared assumption of its target and matches its declaration and source snapshot, and it shows as assumed, never verified. An assumption never proves a component, completes a contract or changes the gate's outcome. Proof and assumption attribution each replace or clear only their own kind. Each first validates a detached copy, together with every record of the other kind, and rejects the whole batch if any record is unknown, duplicated, unselected or stale, leaving the report and its fingerprint as they were. A proof result can also carry its actual invocation, input files and tool pins, which must match what was declared, and earlier proof-only calls stay valid. Fingerprints bind all of it. Attribution only records what a caller supplies: it runs nothing and finds nothing, and explicit component checks stay refused until adapters run them. Explicit receipts say they hold supplied data and declared assumptions, and their Markdown still shows proof coverage only.
